Q: How to properly use the Rx widget in RxFlare for automatic dependency tracking in Flutter? A:

In RxFlare, it is usually best to wrap only the small part of the UI that depends on an observable inside Rx(() => ...). This helps keep rebuilds limited and improves readability and performance. For more control, Rx.custom(deps: [...], builder: ...) can be used when you want to manually define dependencies instead of relying on automatic tracking. Using many Rx() widgets is generally fine as long as each one stays focused on a small widget subtree. For complex screens, it is better to split the UI into smaller widgets and make only the changing parts reactive. In a ListView.builder, Rx() can be used effectively for item-level updates, and you usually do not need to manage disposal for the Rx widget itself unless you are handling other controllers or subscriptions manually.

Q: How to convert comma separated values to rows in oracle? A:

Two solutions based on aggregate formats:

  1. XML

    select id, xmlcast(column_value as varchar2(100)) value
  from tbl1
     , xmltable(('"'||replace(value,',','","')||'"'))

  2. JSON

    select id, v value
  from tbl1
     , json_table('["'||replace(value,',','","')||'"]', '$[*]' columns v varchar2 path '$')

Works for simple data, for completeness proper escaping would need to be implemented.
